# Tool selection 1 — the selection process — answer key

1. Order the stepsSắp các bước
   Answer: a) Identify your tool requirements as evaluation criteria  →  b) Prioritise and weight the criteria  →  c) Set up demos or trials of candidate tools  →  d) Score each candidate against the criteria  →  e) Select the tool and plan a pilot
   Same weighted approach as COTS selection.VI: Cùng cách có trọng số như chọn gói COTS.

exercises.title: Tool selection 2 — setup and adoption: good or risky?
exercises.problemHtml:
Setting up a tool takes effort: installing, loading requirements, defining attributes and trace links, access groups, adapting processes. Assign an experienced BA to own the setup; get an organisation-wide commitment; train users; pilot on a low-risk project; find a champion who advocates the tool. Judge each practice.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Tool selection 3 — the learning curve
exercises.problemHtml:
Some people prefer not to share an imperfect requirement set, yet the database is open to all; people resist leaving familiar documents. Eventually the tool takes no more time — but users must first climb the learning curve.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
